message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates.
• 45 mph on most rural highways, 35 mph on urban highways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child Restraint** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 years or 4 ft 9 in must use a child safety seat.
• Rear‑seat seats are mandatory for children under 13. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held devices are prohibited while driving (unless hands‑free).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | TxCode §545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % is illegal for drivers over 21.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 %).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | TxCode §545.051 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs; yield at yield signs.
• “Move‑over” law: vehicles must change lanes or slow down when approaching stopped emergency vehicles. | TxCode §545.021 | | **Headlights & Visibility** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather.
• Fog lights may only be used when visibility is ≤ 200 ft. | TxCode §545.021 | | **Towing & Vehicle Registration** | • Vehicles must display valid registration stickers.
• Towing regulations require proper permits and equipment. | TxCode §545.021 | | **Parking** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or on sidewalks.
• Parking in a handicap space requires a valid permit. | TxCode §545.021 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus stops to pick up/drop off children.
• Buses have flashing red lights and stop signs. | TxCode §545.021 | | **Lane Discipline** | • Keep to the right lane unless passing.
• Use turn signals at least 100 ft before turning. | TxCode §545.021 | ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – The official source for all statutes. 2. **TxDOT Website** – Offers updates on road conditions, speed limit changes, and driver safety programs. 3. **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – Provides licensing rules, DUI enforcement updates, and driver education resources. Feel free to let me know if you need deeper details on any specific area or help locating a particular regulation!
